source: Starter values from ICAR-NBSS&LUP soil descriptions and state agriculture university guides; ranges are typical, not limits. Review before relying on them.

soils.name: Black soil (regur)
soils.signs: Dark grey to black; deep cracks when dry; very sticky and swells when wet.
soils.fertility: Rich in calcium, magnesium and potash; low in nitrogen and phosphorus.
soils.found: Deccan plateau: Maharashtra, Telangana, Karnataka, Madhya Pradesh, Gujarat.
soils.suits: Cotton, soybean, sorghum, chickpea, pigeon pea, sunflower, wheat with irrigation.

soils.name: Red sandy soil (chalka)
soils.signs: Red or reddish brown; gritty between the fingers; drains fast and dries quickly; forms a crust after rain.
soils.fertility: Low in nitrogen, phosphorus and organic matter.
soils.found: Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Odisha.
soils.suits: Groundnut, millets, pulses, castor; vegetables and orchards with irrigation.

soils.name: Red loamy soil
soils.signs: Red to brown; crumbles well in the hand; holds some water.
soils.suits: Ragi, maize, groundnut, pulses, vegetables, mango and other orchards.

soils.name: Laterite soil
soils.signs: Brick red; hardens like brick when dry; pebbly; under heavy rain.
soils.fertility: Acidic; low in nitrogen, phosphorus, potash and lime.
soils.found: Western Ghats, Kerala, Konkan, Odisha, Assam hills.
soils.suits: Cashew, coconut, rubber, tea, coffee, pineapple; rice in valleys.

soils.name: Alluvial soil (loam)
soils.signs: Light grey to brown; soft and fine; easy to plough; along rivers.
soils.found: Indo-Gangetic plains, river valleys and deltas.
soils.suits: Wheat, rice, sugarcane, maize, pulses, oilseeds, vegetables.

soils.name: Delta clay (heavy alluvium)
soils.signs: Dark and heavy; stays wet long after rain; puddles easily.
soils.found: Godavari, Krishna, Kaveri and other deltas.
soils.suits: Rice, then pulses (black gram, green gram) in the rice fallow; sugarcane, banana.

soils.name: Desert sand
soils.signs: Loose yellow-brown sand; no lumps; water vanishes at once.
soils.fertility: Very low organic matter; may be salty.
soils.found: Rajasthan, Kutch, parts of Haryana and Punjab.
soils.suits: Pearl millet, cluster bean, moth bean, sesame; with drip, many more.

soils.name: Saline or alkaline soil (usar)
soils.signs: White crust on the surface when dry; patchy, stunted crops; water stands on alkaline patches.
soils.fertility: Salt or sodium limits most crops until reclaimed (gypsum, drainage).
soils.found: Irrigated canal areas in Punjab, Haryana, Uttar Pradesh; coastal belts.
soils.suits: Barley, cotton, mustard, salt-tolerant rice varieties, quinoa; after reclamation, most crops.

soils.name: Coastal sandy soil
soils.signs: Light sand near the coast; may be slightly salty.

soils.name: Hill and forest soil
soils.signs: Dark brown and rich in leaf litter on slopes; acidic.
soils.found: Himalayas, Western and Eastern Ghats, north-east.
soils.suits: Tea, coffee, spices, temperate fruit, potato.

soils.name: Peaty or marshy soil
soils.signs: Black, spongy and wet; smells of rotting plants.
